instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a fully robust biometric attendance tracker in React Native / Expo web featuring: 1) Daily punch dashboard with Morning & Evening sessions in Asia/Kolkata time; 2) Prominent Punch controls with duplicate and conflict prevention; 3) Edit and Delete entry modals with exact time picker; 4) Configurable reminders and web browser notifications; 5) Attendance History with date/month filters and missed-punch view; 6) Weekly/Monthly summary statistics, complete days, missed punches count, and attendance percentage charts; 7) Full Supabase integration and offline fallback storage support. Ensure every interactive element includes data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case
Never use complete transparent backgrounds for headers or sticky elements
Maintain high contrast compliant with WCAG AA/APCA standards
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6) for clean UI breathing room
Ensure Asia/Kolkata timezone is accurately utilized for daily punch validation
